SELECT m.id, m.logo_url, m.is_enable, m.created_time, m.contact_name, m.contact_phone, m.business_status, m.name AS merchantName, CONCAT(m.location, m.address_detail) AS addressDetail, i.name AS industryName
FROM merchants AS m LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.name}, '%')
AND m.id IN
CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT)
AND m.industry_id IN
CAST(#{id} AS BIGINT)
AND m.business_status IN
#{status}
AND m.is_enable = ${dto.enable ? 1 : 0}
AND JSON_OVERLAPS(m.region_code, #{dto.regionCodeJsonStr}) = 1
ORDER BY
m.created_time DESC
m.created_time ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, i.id AS industryId, i.name AS industryName
FROM merchants AS m LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id
WHERE m.id IN
#{id}

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, logo_url AS merchantLogoUrl, m.description, contact_name, contact_phone, address_detail AS merchantAddress, business_status AS merchantBusinessStatus, i.name AS industryName FROM merchants AS m LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.name AS storeName, s.phone AS storePhone, s.logo_url AS storeLogo, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.store_score, s.business_hours, s.business_status, JSON_EXTRACT(s.images, '$[0 to 19]') AS storeImages, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS storeAddress, m.id AS merchantId, m.description, m.industry_id, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, m.name AS merchantName, JSON_EXTRACT(m.images, '$[0 to 9]') AS merchantImages, i.name AS industryName, ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE(POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), POINT(s.longitude, s.latitude)) / 1000 AS distance
FROM merchants AS m JOIN stores AS s ON m.id = s.merchant_id LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id
WHERE s.is_enable = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.business_status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED') AND m.is_enable = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.business_status NOT IN ('SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATED') AND m.id = #{merchantId}
ORDER BY distance LIMIT 1

WITH rankedStores AS (
SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.name AS storeName, s.logo_url AS storeLogo, s.phone AS storePhone, s.business_hours, s.business_status, s.store_score, CONCAT(s.location, s.address_detail) AS storeAddress, m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, m.industry_id, i.name AS industryName, ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE( POINT(s.longitude, s.latitude), POINT(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude}) ) / 1000 AS distance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.id ORDER BY ST_DISTANCE_SPHERE( POINT(s.longitude, s.latitude), POINT(#{dto.longitude}, #{dto.latitude}) )) AS rn
FROM merchants AS m INNER JOIN stores AS s ON m.id = s.merchant_id LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id
WHERE m.is_enable = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.business_status = 'OPERATING'
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.name}, '%')
AND m.industry_id = CAST(#{dto.industryId} AS BIGINT)
AND s.is_enable = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.business_status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DELETED') AND i.is_enable = 1 ANd i.is_deleted = 0 )
SELECT storeId, storeName, storeLogo, storePhone, business_hours, business_status, store_score, storeAddress, merchantId, merchantName, merchantLogo, industry_id, industryName, distance
FROM rankedStores WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY
store_score ${dto.sortByScore ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'},
distance

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogo, m.address_detail AS merchantAddress, m.description, m.industry_id, m.created_time, i.name AS industryName FROM merchants AS m LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enable = 1
SELECT id, license_no, license_images AS licenseImage, legal_person FROM merchants WHERE id = #{merchantId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT images FROM merchants WHERE id = #{merchantId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id AS merchantId, name AS merchantName, logo_url AS merchantLogo FROM merchants
WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_enable = 1
AND industry_id IN
#{id}
AND JSON_OVERLAPS(region_code -> '$[*]', CAST(#{regionCodes} AS JSON))

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, m.logo_url AS merchantLogoUrl, i.name AS industryName
FROM merchants AS m LEFT JOIN industries AS i ON m.industry_id = i.id
WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enable = 1 AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.is_enable = 1
AND m.industry_id IN
#{id}
AND JSON_OVERLAPS(m.region_code -> '$[*]', CAST(#{dto.regionCodeJson} AS JSON))
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT( #{dto.merchantName}, '%')
ORDER BY m.industry_id, m.created_time DESC
